# orion theme

Add, list, or remove theme files

```sh
orion theme <command> [options]
```

## orion theme add

Copy a theme file into the data folder, where the app lists it

```sh
orion theme add [file] [options]
```

| Argument | Description                                        |
| -------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `[file]` | Theme file (JSON with light and dark token values) |
| `--json` | Print JSON                                         |

## orion theme list

List the theme files in the data folder

```sh
orion theme list [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion theme remove

Delete a theme file from the data folder

```sh
orion theme remove [file] [options]
```

| Argument | Description                             |
| -------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `[file]` | Theme file name, as theme list shows it |
| `--json` | Print JSON                              |
